install_steps: Download k0sctl for your platform from https://github.com/k0sproject/k0sctl/releases and move it to PATH
note: Driven by a k0sctl.yaml describing hosts (SSH) and the desired k0s spec. 'k0sctl apply' converges the cluster — safe to re-run for upgrades and scaling. Fetch the admin kubeconfig with 'k0sctl kubeconfig'.
